nodes.description: InvaderAcademy._currentTokenId: counter of minted tokens used for supply and Tesla draw math
MAX_SUPPLY = 7777 hard cap on total minted tokens
baseTokenURI prefix used to build token metadata URIs
NFT_price = 0.042 ether, exact value required by buy()
startTime: sale opening timestamp, initialized from block.timestamp
teslaOwner: address selected as Tesla Model Y winner
Ownable._owner private owner address
NativeMetaTransaction.nonces mapping (address => uint256) preventing replay
EIP712Base.domainSeperator used for typed message hashing
Initializable.inited flag guarding one-time initialization
ERC721._balances mapping (owner => token count)
ERC721._owners mapping (tokenId => owner)
ERC721._tokenApprovals mapping (tokenId => approved address)
ERC721._operatorApprovals nested mapping of operator permissions
ERC721Enumerable._allTokens array of every token id
ERC721Enumerable._ownedTokens mapping of owner token lists
Migrations.last_completed_migration tracking migration step
Migrations.owner set from msg.sender in the constructor
ERC721._name token collection name string
ERC721._symbol token collection symbol string
buy(): payable public mint gated by block.timestamp, exact price and MAX_SUPPLY
mintTo(address): onlyOwner mint to an arbitrary address
withdraw(): onlyOwner transfer of entire contract balance to owner
set_start_time(uint256): onlyOwner setter for sale start timestamp
_getNextTokenId(): returns _currentTokenId + 1 via SafeMath.add
_incrementTokenId(): increments counter and runs the Tesla random draw at MAX_SUPPLY-1
randomHash(): pseudo-random uint from coinbase, timestamp and difficulty
setBaseUri(string): onlyOwner setter for baseTokenURI
tokenURI(uint256): view returning baseTokenURI concatenated with token id
_msgSender() override in InvaderAcademy delegating to ContextMixin.msgSender (meta-tx aware)
InvaderAcademy constructor: sets name/symbol and initializes EIP712
executeMetaTransaction(): verifies signature, bumps nonce and performs a low-level call on address(this)
verify(): ecrecover-based signer validation for meta transactions
hashMetaTransaction(): EIP712 struct hash of the meta transaction
getNonce(address): view returning the current nonce of a user
_setOwner(address): private writer of the _owner state variable
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner ownership transfer
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner sets owner to the zero address
_mint(address,uint256): internal ERC721 mint updating balances and owners
_safeMint(): internal mint that checks the receiver contract callback
_transfer(address,address,uint256): internal ERC721 ownership transfer
_burn(uint256): internal ERC721 burn clearing approvals and enumeration
_approve(address,uint256): internal writer of _tokenApprovals
_checkOnERC721Received(): private external call to onERC721Received with try/catch
safeTransferFrom(): public ERC721 safe transfer entrypoint
transferFrom(): public ERC721 transfer entrypoint
approve(address,uint256): public ERC721 approval entrypoint
setApprovalForAll(address,bool): public operator approval entrypoint
balanceOf(address): view returning token count from _balances
ownerOf(uint256): view returning owner and reverting for nonexistent tokens
_exists(uint256): internal existence check on _owners
_isApprovedOrOwner(): internal spender authorization check
supportsInterface(bytes4): ERC165 interface detection across overrides
tokenOfOwnerByIndex(): enumeration view using balanceOf bounds
totalSupply(): view returning _allTokens.length
tokenByIndex(): enumeration view with global index bounds check
_beforeTokenTransfer(): ERC721Enumerable hook maintaining enumeration data
_addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(): private owner-side enumeration insert
_removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(): private owner-side enumeration swap-and-pop removal
Migrations.setCompleted(uint): writes last_completed_migration under the restricted modifier
Migrations.upgrade(address): restricted call into a new Migrations instance
Address.functionCallWithValue(): low-level call with value forwarding
Address.sendValue(): raw call transferring ETH to a payable recipient
_initializeEIP712(string): initializer-guarded domain separator setup
_setDomainSeperator(string): computes and stores the EIP712 domain separator
getChainId(): returns chainid() via inline assembly
getDomainSeperator(): view returning the stored domain separator
toTypedMessageHash(bytes32): EIP191/EIP712 wrapped digest
Address.verifyCallResult(): bubbles revert reasons from low-level calls
IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received(): external receiver callback invoked during safe transfers
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender
msg.sender: caller/relayer identity used for minting, authorization and meta-transactions
block.timestamp: used for sale gating and pseudo-randomness in the Tesla draw
payable mint path in buy(): accepts ETH and mints without refund of excess value
withdraw(): transfers the entire contract balance to owner()
Tesla draw indexes ownerOf with computed/underflowing expressions that can revert or revert the mint
Address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)): arbitrary low-level call with attacker-controlled calldata
Migrations.restricted pattern: if (msg.sender == owner) _; which silently allows execution when the check fails
External call to onERC721Received during safe transfer, transferring control to the token receiver
Weak on-chain randomness derived from block.coinbase, block.timestamp and block.difficulty
mintTo parameter _to: destination address of the minted token
local newTokenId computed in buy()/mintTo() from _getNextTokenId()
set_start_time parameter time: new sale opening timestamp
setBaseUri parameter _uri: new metadata base URI
tokenURI parameter _tokenId: token id used for URI generation
setCompleted parameter completed: migration step number
upgrade parameter new_address: target Migrations contract address
executeMetaTransaction parameter userAddress: signer whose nonce is consumed
executeMetaTransaction parameter functionSignature: raw calldata to execute
transferOwnership parameter newOwner: incoming owner address
local rand in _incrementTokenId: randomHash() % 1000
local txHash in _incrementTokenId: keccak256 of ownerOf selections and msg.sender

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside buy()
msg.sender flows from buy() into _mint() as the _to argument
mintTo is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender()
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner gating on the caller identity
transferFrom authorizes the caller via _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId)
safeTransferFrom authorizes the caller via _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId)
setApprovalForAll writes _operatorApprovals[_msgSender()][operator]
executeMetaTransaction pays the relayer via payable(msg.sender)
Migrations constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
msg.sender stored as the Migrations owner state variable
buy() completion is gated by block.timestamp >= startTime
randomHash() mixes block.timestamp into the pseudo-random seed
startTime state variable is initialized to block.timestamp at deployment
startTime is read by the buy() timestamp requirement
NFT_price is compared against msg.value in buy()
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the mint in buy()
MAX_SUPPLY bounds the mint in mintTo()
MAX_SUPPLY is used for the bounds check and draw math in _incrementTokenId()
_getNextTokenId reads _currentTokenId
_incrementTokenId increments and reads _currentTokenId
buy() reads _currentTokenId for the supply check
mintTo() reads _currentTokenId for the supply check
buy() calls _getNextTokenId() to compute the new token id
buy() calls _mint(msg.sender, newTokenId)
buy() calls _incrementTokenId() after minting
mintTo() calls _getNextTokenId()
mintTo() calls _mint(_to, newTokenId)
mintTo() calls _incrementTokenId() after minting
_incrementTokenId() calls randomHash() when the cap is nearly reached
_incrementTokenId() calls ownerOf() with many computed indices for the draw
_incrementTokenId() assigns the computed winner to teslaOwner
randomHash() depends on miner-controllable block.timestamp
_mint() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_mint() checks token existence through _exists()
_mint() increments _balances[to]
_mint() writes _owners[tokenId] = to
_safeMint() calls _mint() before the receiver check
_safeMint() calls _checkOnERC721Received() after minting
_transfer() verifies ownership via ERC721.ownerOf()
_transfer() clears approvals through _approve()
_transfer() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_transfer() updates _balances for both parties
_transfer() rewrites _owners[tokenId]
_burn() reads the owner via ERC721.ownerOf()
_burn() clears approvals through _approve(address(0), tokenId)
_burn() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_checkOnERC721Received() performs an external call to onERC721Received on the receiver contract, yielding control
_checkOnERC721Received() passes _msgSender() as the operator argument
safeTransferFrom reaches the receiver callback via _safeTransfer -> _checkOnERC721Received
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer()
approve() delegates to _approve()
setApprovalForAll() writes _operatorApprovals
ownerOf() reads _owners[tokenId]
_isApprovedOrOwner() calls ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId)
_isApprovedOrOwner() consults getApproved/isApprovedForAll authorization
executeMetaTransaction() requires verify(userAddress, metaTx, sigR, sigS, sigV)
executeMetaTransaction() reads and increments nonces[userAddress]
userAddress parameter drives the nonce lookup and the appended calldata
functionSignature parameter is packed into the low-level call data
verify() calls hashMetaTransaction(metaTx)
verify() calls toTypedMessageHash() before ecrecover
hashMetaTransaction() consumes the stored nonce
_initializeEIP712() calls _setDomainSeperator(name) under the initializer modifier
_setDomainSeperator() writes domainSeperator
_setDomainSeperator() calls getChainId() for the domain field
toTypedMessageHash() reads getDomainSeperator()
InvaderAcademy constructor calls _initializeEIP712(_name)
Ownable constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender())
_setOwner() writes the _owner state variable
transferOwnership() is onlyOwner and then calls _setOwner(newOwner)
renounceOwnership() is onlyOwner and then calls _setOwner(address(0))
setCompleted() writes last_completed_migration under the restricted modifier
upgrade() performs an external call to setCompleted on a separate Migrations instance
functionCallWithValue() routes the call result through verifyCallResult()
_beforeTokenTransfer() adds tokens to owner enumeration on mint
_beforeTokenTransfer() removes tokens from owner enumeration on transfer/burn
tokenOfOwnerByIndex() bounds the index with ERC721.balanceOf(owner)
tokenByIndex() bounds the index with ERC721Enumerable.totalSupply()
_msgSender() override ultimately returns msg.sender when not an internal meta-transaction call
buy() stores the next id into the newTokenId local
mintTo() passes parameter _to into _mint
_incrementTokenId() computes the rand local used as the draw offset
_incrementTokenId() builds the txHash local from ownerOf results and msg.sender
buy() is the payable mint entrypoint represented by the unsafe_buy_mint operation
withdraw() executes the balance transfer represented by unsafe_withdraw_transfer
_incrementTokenId() performs ownerOf arithmetic (e.g. _currentTokenId - 9000 + rand) that can underflow/revert
executeMetaTransaction() performs an arbitrary low-level call on address(this), forwarding control
setCompleted() authorization relies on the msg.sender == owner restricted pattern
_checkOnERC721Received() external call is represented by unsafe_checkOnERC721Received_call
randomHash() produces predictable values from miner-influenced block attributes
sendValue() forwards its raw call result into verifyCallResult-style handling

normalization_plan.reason: mintTo's _to parameter is only meaningful as the destination argument of that function
newTokenId is a transient local produced and consumed inside the buy() mint flow
the time parameter only feeds the startTime assignment in set_start_time
the _uri parameter only feeds the baseTokenURI assignment in setBaseUri
_tokenId is a parameter of tokenURI used only for URI string building
completed is the migration step argument written by setCompleted
new_address is only used to instantiate the Migrations target inside upgrade
userAddress is the signer/nonce key consumed by executeMetaTransaction
functionSignature is the raw calldata packed into executeMetaTransaction's low-level call
newOwner is only used by transferOwnership before being stored via _setOwner
rand is a transient local computed and consumed inside _incrementTokenId's draw
txHash is a transient local built and consumed inside _incrementTokenId's draw
